source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: Advanced address-book search enables Any Number for both Match-any and Match-all validity tables, then expands it into five phone fields. The dialog uses one flat query operator and only replaces a trailing and with or before appending the phone terms. This is an explicit compromise for the flat query format, not nested Boolean support: after other terms have already been serialized, and is no longer the URI suffix. The Bug corrects the earlier never-shown premise to Match-any-only. Preserve that limitation when reasoning about combined criteria. No search or provider test ran, and no new test was part of the patch.
title: Keep the flat Any Number search fallback scoped
